title: Homotopy representatives of the relative comparison on a covering pair
statement: Assume derived module categories [def-pc-derived-category] for all schemes. Let f:X→S, f′:X′→S′, g:S′→S, g′:X′→X form a cartesian square. Let K∈D(O_X), K′∈D(O_X′), and φ:Lg′*K→K′, using [def-pc-derived-pullback]. Let U,V be opens of X with U union V=X. Write a for relativeMVGlobalArrow and b(T) for relativeMVLocalArrow at T, constructed with the pinned comparisons [def-pc-relative-mv-maps]. There are four cochain complexes C,D,C′,D′ on S′, chain maps t:C→D, t′:C′→D′, α:C→C′, β:D→D′, a homotopy H:t;β~α;t′, and isomorphisms from Q(C), Q(D), Q(Cone t) to a.left, b(U).left⊕b(V).left, b(U intersection V).left, and similarly on the right. Under these isomorphisms Q(α), Q(β), and Q(mapOfHomotopy H) equal respectively a.hom, biprod.map b(U).hom b(V).hom, and b(U intersection V).hom. No coefficient is required to be a single complex, and no affine, quasi-compactness or quasi-coherence hypothesis is assumed.

source.place: cohomology.tex, lemma-exact-sequence-j-star (08BV), lemma-unbounded-relative-mayer-vietoris (08HZ), lemma-restrict-direct-image-open (08FE), remark-base-change (08HY); resolved comparison before coefficient normalization.

proof.text: Resolve K and K′ with injective terms. Apply the K-injective Mayer-Vietoris presentation to the cover and its inverse image. The exact rows identify the cones with the respective overlap terms.

Transpose φ, represent it by a chain map into a K-injective resolution and restrict that map to the cover. Compute relative direct images, and take compatible K-flat resolutions of the finite source diagram before applying tensor pullback. Naturality of the units and the underived open counit square specify the homotopy H of its first square. Keep H in the cone map.

Use direct-image composition and exact open restriction to identify all vertices. At the middle use the additive biproduct comparison. Expand the relative arrows as mates. The composite counit formula identifies the localized union and two member maps; applying the same comparison to the resolved rows identifies the specified homotopy cone map with the overlap arrow.

theorem relativeMV_cover_homotopy_data
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    {X S X' S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (hpull : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) (K' : schemeDerivedCategory X')
    (φ : (derivedPullback g').obj K ⟶ K')
    (U V : X.Opens) (hcover : U ⊔ V = ⊤) :
    let a := relativeMVGlobalArrow f f' g g' hpull K K' φ
    let b := relativeMVLocalArrow f f' g g' hpull K K' φ
    ∃ (C D C' D' : CochainComplex
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S'.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
      (t : C ⟶ D) (t' : C' ⟶ D') (α : C ⟶ C') (β : D ⟶ D'),
      ∃ (H : Homotopy (t ≫ β) (α ≫ t'))
        (e₁ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj C ≅ a.left)
        (e₂ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj D ≅ (b U).left ⊞ (b V).left)
        (e₃ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj (CochainComplex.mappingCone t) ≅ (b (U ⊓ V)).left)
        (e₁' : DerivedCategory.Q.obj C' ≅ a.right)
        (e₂' : DerivedCategory.Q.obj D' ≅ (b U).right ⊞ (b V).right)
        (e₃' : DerivedCategory.Q.obj (CochainComplex.mappingCone t') ≅ (b (U ⊓ V)).right),
        DerivedCategory.Q.map α ≫ e₁'.hom = e₁.hom ≫ a.hom ∧
        DerivedCategory.Q.map β ≫ e₂'.hom =
          e₂.hom ≫ biprod.map (b U).hom (b V).hom ∧
        DerivedCategory.Q.map (CochainComplex.mappingCone.mapOfHomotopy H) ≫ e₃'.hom =
          e₃.hom ≫ (b (U ⊓ V)).hom
